Rasmus Gaardskær Nielsen is a medical professional and academic who serves on the steering group of the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. He represents Region Syddanmark (Region of Southern Denmark) in this national registry, holding the professional titles of chief physician (overlæge), Ph.D., and clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor) [^src1]. 

Within the context of DANIBD's operations, the steering group functions as the strategic management unit for the registry [^src1]. Nielsen's involvement highlights his dual role as both a clinical expert and an education lead, contributing to the broader national effort to systematize and improve inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment in Denmark [^src1]. This work encompasses supporting cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, clinical benchmarking, and the evaluation of treatment access across the country's healthcare regions [^src1].
